linguistic_indicators.name: code_switching_ratio
linguistic_indicators.definition: Smaller of the detected Filipino and English word counts, divided by their combined count. Ambiguous words are excluded; maximum 0.5.
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Ang mas maliit na bilang ng natukoy na salitang Filipino o English, hinati sa pinagsamang bilang. Hindi kasama ang mga salitang hindi tiyak ang wika; hanggang 0.5 lamang.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.

linguistic_indicators.name: filipino_particle_frequency
linguistic_indicators.definition: Alphabetic tokens matching the saved Filipino-particle list, divided by all non-space tokens, including punctuation.
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Bilang ng mga salitang tumugma sa naka-save na listahan ng katagang Filipino, hinati sa lahat ng token na hindi espasyo, kasama ang bantas.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.

linguistic_indicators.name: punctuation_intensity
linguistic_indicators.definition: Exclamation-mark and question-mark characters divided by all characters.
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Bilang ng tandang padamdam at pananong, hinati sa lahat ng character.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.

linguistic_indicators.name: capitalization_ratio
linguistic_indicators.definition: Uppercase alphabetic characters divided by all alphabetic characters.
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Bilang ng malalaking titik, hinati sa lahat ng titik.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.

linguistic_indicators.name: repeated_character_ratio
linguistic_indicators.definition: Characters in case-sensitive runs of three or more identical characters, divided by all characters.
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Mga character sa magkakasunod na tatlo o higit pang eksaktong magkaparehong character, hinati sa lahat ng character.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.

linguistic_indicators.name: emotional_language_frequency
linguistic_indicators.definition: Alphabetic tokens matching the saved emotion-word list, divided by all non-space tokens.
linguistic_indicators.display_name_tagalog: Mga salitang may kaugnayan sa emosyon
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Bilang ng mga salitang tumugma sa naka-save na listahan ng salitang emosyonal, hinati sa lahat ng token na hindi espasyo.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.

linguistic_indicators.name: urgency_cue_frequency
linguistic_indicators.definition: Alphabetic tokens matching the saved urgency-word list, divided by all non-space tokens.
linguistic_indicators.definition_tagalog: Bilang ng mga salitang tumugma sa naka-save na listahan ng salitang nagpapahiwatig ng pagmamadali, hinati sa lahat ng token na hindi espasyo.
linguistic_indicators.interpretation: Text signal; not feature importance or proof of falsehood.
